message.Title: Public Preview: Application Gateway for Containers Istio Service Mesh integration

Body.Content:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports integration with Istio service mesh through an optional service mesh extension. This feature simplifies secure north-south communication between external clients and services within the service mesh. 

  • Single solution: Load balance traffic to services both inside and outside the mesh through one ingress gateway.  
  • Reduced operational overhead: Eliminate configuration bloat by automating repetitive mutual authentication definitions.  
  • Certificate trust and rotation: Managed certificate trust and rotation to maintain secure authentication with the service mesh.  

Learn more: 

  • Application Gateway for Containers + Istio service mesh 
  • Application Gateway for Containers Overview
